requested_scope: target-device timing and physical board interoperability
required_inputs: Actual FPGA part/package/speed grade and board model
Pin map, I/O standards, clocks, resets, PHY interface and setup/hold budgets
Accessible powered board and programming/debug interface
Connected independent AFDX peer(s), capture timestamps and calibrated traffic source
acceptance_conditions: Target-specific synthesis and place/route succeeds with resource headroom
All setup/hold, recovery/removal paths meet reviewed constraints at required corners
No unexplained unconstrained endpoints or unjustified timing exceptions
Independent A/B wire captures validate traffic, failures, recovery and time synchronization
